svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 09 (plan): arrival and hand-out
svg.text: 09 · It's here: hand-out, "Everyone got theirs", who paid the holder (holder)
Redrawn for the plan: one press ticks everyone (U4 note); the Paid column only when the order settles to the holder (M1, U12 note).
A · Hand out, paid to the holder

g.text: Everyone in the order was told
Ticks every pizza at once · undo for 10 s

svg.text: B · Hand out, settled through the organiser

g.text: Everyone in the order was told
People pay after the event. Nothing to collect.

svg.text: C · After "Everyone got theirs": done

g.text: Paid you: Demo Player, Player Two
Each person sees only their own mark:

svg.text: One press for everyone (U4 note)
"Everyone got theirs" ticks every pizza at once, so
the holder does not tap a list at the door. Undo for
10 s; single ticks still work, and "I've got mine" on
the attendee's page ticks the same box (U9).
The order is done
When every pizza is ticked, the order is done:
pizza.order.done (D3), and the screens' "Pizza orders
ready" story may end on it. Without ticks, the timer
does it 2 h after arrival (O7).
Paid you: only when it settles to the holder
The event setting "Let holders take payment directly"
(mockup 17) allows it; the holder then chooses per
order (U12 note, M1). Settled through the organiser
(B), there is no Paid column: people pay after the
event through the payment system.
Amounts come from the order's money
Each row shows what the person owes, as mockup 19
works it out: exact from prices, or an even share per
pizza. Who sees a tick: the holder and the crew; each
person their own (U12 A).
Nudge
One push to the people not yet ticked, once per order
Nobody at the door
U5 B: venue staff get no door helper; the delivery
asks for the holder, and the crew can still mark it
arrived from the crew's Food page.
